title: Design-Build for Fiber Community Transitions Building
short_description: Design-build services for fiber design and installation at a new school district building.
project_scope: Design and installation of fiber infrastructure to serve the new Community Transitions building for Bellingham School District No. 501. services: Design-build services for fiber design and installation; electrical engineering.

- No bridge, long-span roof, special structure, stadium, or complex building structure component is indicated.
